extras.price_note: the two seed columns disagree because talaria applied a USD 250 a month surcharge floor to the metered rate and nemo did not. The metered bill at 2 vCPU / 4 GiB is 300 h x (2 x USD 0.015 + 4 x USD 0.008) = 300 x USD 0.062 = USD 18.60, less the USD 5 monthly credit = USD 13.60, which is nemo's column. The USD 250 is a plan floor that this workload never reaches
extras.dispute: talaria USD 263.60 vs nemo USD 13.01. The plan said the USD 250 is a surcharge floor rather than a minimum bill, so talaria's column is the floor applied to a workload that never reaches it. nemo is the metered bill. Both numbers are reproducible and only one is a bill
